Here is the idiomatic `knr-ops` implementation for the requested changes. The solution follows GitOps best practices, uses ACK CRDs, leverages Kustomize overlays for environment isolation, and integrates SOPS for sensitive values.

### 📁 Repository Structure Changes
```
infra/s3/logs/base/
  ├── kustomization.yaml
  ├── bucket.yaml
  ├── iam-role.yaml
  ├── iam-policy.yaml
  ├── iam-policy-attachment.yaml
  └── serviceaccount.yaml
overlays/dev/
  ├── kustomization.yaml          # (add ref to logs/base)
  └── infra-s3-logs-patch.yaml
overlays/prod/
  ├── kustomization.yaml          # (add ref to logs/base)
  └── infra-s3-logs-patch.yaml
flux/
  └── kustomization-s3-logs.yaml
se
